command:
set -eu
PKG=io.blueeye
adb start-server >/dev/null
SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device"{print $1; exit}')
[ -n "$SERIAL" ] || exit 31
adbx(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" "$@"; }
OUT=/tmp/tracker-phase2-remaining
rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT/db"

# Obtain current Scan button coordinate after fresh launch.
adbx shell am force-stop $PKG; sleep 2
adbx logcat -c
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 3
SERVICE_IDLE=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ServiceRecord.*io.blueeye/.service.ScannerService' || true)
echo IDLE_RELAUNCH_SERVICE=$SERVICE_IDLE
[ "$SERVICE_IDLE" -eq 0 ] || { echo IDLE_RELAUNCH_GATE=FAIL; exit 32; }
adbx shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/blueeye-window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1
adbx exec-out cat /sdcard/blueeye-window.xml > "$OUT/window.xml"
XY=$(python3 - "$OUT/window.xml" <<'PY'
import re,sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
for n in ET.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot().iter('node'):
 if n.attrib.get('content-desc')=='Scan':
  m=re.match(r'\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]',n.attrib.get('bounds',''))
  if m:
   a,b,c,d=map(int,m.groups()); print((a+c)//2,(b+d)//2); break
PY
)
[ -n "$XY" ] || exit 33
X=$(echo "$XY"|awk '{print $1}'); Y=$(echo "$XY"|awk '{print $2}')
tap_scan(){ adbx shell input tap "$X" "$Y" >/dev/null; }

# Idle Bluetooth OFF/ON must not create service.
adbx shell svc bluetooth disable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 5
adbx shell svc bluetooth enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 8
SERVICE_IDLE_BT=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ServiceRecord.*io.blueeye/.service.ScannerService' || true)
echo IDLE_BT_SERVICE=$SERVICE_IDLE_BT
[ "$SERVICE_IDLE_BT" -eq 0 ] || { echo IDLE_BT_GATE=FAIL; exit 34; }
echo IDLE_BT_GATE=PASS

# Explicit start then process force-stop/relaunch.
tap_scan; sleep 6
SERVICE_STARTED=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ServiceRecord.*io.blueeye/.service.ScannerService' || true)
[ "$SERVICE_STARTED" -eq 1 ] || { echo PROCESS_GATE=FAIL_START; exit 35; }
PID_BEFORE=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
adbx shell am force-stop $PKG; sleep 4
PID_STOP=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
SERVICE_STOP=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ServiceRecord.*io.blueeye/.service.ScannerService' || true)
echo PROCESS_BEFORE=$PID_BEFORE AFTER_FORCE_STOP="$PID_STOP" SERVICE_AFTER_FORCE_STOP=$SERVICE_STOP
[ -z "$PID_STOP" ] && [ "$SERVICE_STOP" -eq 0 ] || { echo PROCESS_GATE=FAIL_FORCE_STOP; exit 36; }
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 4
SERVICE_RELAUNCH=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ServiceRecord.*io.blueeye/.service.ScannerService' || true)
echo SERVICE_AFTER_RELAUNCH=$SERVICE_RELAUNCH
[ "$SERVICE_RELAUNCH" -eq 0 ] || { echo PROCESS_GATE=FAIL_AUTO_START; exit 37; }
# refresh coordinate after process recreation
adbx shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/blueeye-window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1; adbx exec-out cat /sdcard/blueeye-window.xml > "$OUT/window2.xml"
XY=$(python3 - "$OUT/window2.xml" <<'PY'
import re,sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
for n in ET.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot().iter('node'):
 if n.attrib.get('content-desc')=='Scan':
  m=re.match(r'\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]',n.attrib.get('bounds',''))
  if m:
   a,b,c,d=map(int,m.groups()); print((a+c)//2,(b+d)//2); break
PY
)
X=$(echo "$XY"|awk '{print $1}'); Y=$(echo "$XY"|awk '{print $2}')
tap_scan; sleep 6
SERVICE_RESTART=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ServiceRecord.*io.blueeye/.service.ScannerService' || true)
[ "$SERVICE_RESTART" -eq 1 ] || { echo PROCESS_GATE=FAIL_EXPLICIT_START; exit 38; }
echo PROCESS_GATE=PASS

# Screen sleep/wake should preserve same service without lifecycle restart.
START0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
RUN0=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
PID0=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r')
adbx shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP; sleep 10
PIDS=$(adbx shell pidof $PKG | tr -d '\r' || true)
SERVICE_SLEEP=$(adbx shell dumpsys activity services $PKG | grep -c 'ServiceRecord.*io.blueeye/.service.ScannerService' || true)
adbx shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP; sleep 5
START1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=START_REQUESTED' || true)
RUN1=$(adbx logcat -d | grep -c 'ScannerService: lifecycle=RUNNING' || true)
echo SCREEN_PID=$PID0/$PIDS SERVICE=$SERVICE_SLEEP START=$START0/$START1 RUNNING=$RUN0/$RUN1
[ "$PID0" = "$PIDS" ] && [ "$SERVICE_SLEEP" -eq 1 ] && [ "$START0" = "$START1" ] && [ "$RUN0" = "$RUN1" ] || { echo SCREEN_GATE=FAIL; exit 39; }
echo SCREEN_GATE=PASS

# DB snapshot/integrity after all lifecycle stress; no deletion.
adbx shell am force-stop $PKG; sleep 2
LIST=$(adbx shell run-as $PKG ls -1 databases 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true)
printf '%s\n' "$LIST" | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -n "$f" ] || continue; adbx exec-out run-as $PKG cat "databases/$f" > "$OUT/db/$f" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$OUT/db/$f"; done
python3 - "$OUT/db" <<'PY'
import os,sqlite3,sys,json
d=sys.argv[1]; ok=False
for f in os.listdir(d):
 if f.endswith(('-wal','-shm','-journal')): continue
 p=os.path.join(d,f)
 try:
  c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro',uri=True); integ=c.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
  tables=[r[0] for r in c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and name not like 'sqlite_%' order by name")]
  counts={t:c.execute('select count(*) from "'+t.replace('\"','\"\"')+'"').fetchone()[0] for t in tables}
  print('DB_FINAL',json.dumps({'file':f,'integrity':integ,'tables':counts},sort_keys=True)); c.close(); ok |= integ=='ok'
 except Exception: pass
if not ok: raise SystemExit(40)
PY
echo DB_GATE=PASS

# Relaunch but leave scanner stopped, user can continue using phone normally.
adbx shell am start -W -n $PKG/.MainActivity >/dev/null || true
adbx logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -E 'ScannerService.*lifecycle=|FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in io.blueeye|SecurityException' | tail -800 > "$OUT/final-log.txt" || true
python3 - "$OUT/final-log.txt" <<'PY'
import sys
s=open(sys.argv[1],errors='ignore').read(); print('FATAL_COUNT',s.count('FATAL EXCEPTION')); print('ANR_COUNT',s.count('ANR in io.blueeye')); print('SECURITY_EXCEPTION_COUNT',s.count('SecurityException'))
if s.count('FATAL EXCEPTION') or s.count('ANR in io.blueeye') or s.count('SecurityException'): raise SystemExit(41)
PY
echo REMAINING_DEVICE_FLOW=PASS
